requirements.text: Define one strict shared runtime contract for exact Direct-BGP results.
Bind every result to dataset, snapshot, query, BGP, active dataset, graph authorization, OWL signature and datatype policy identities.
Represent RDF terms and SPARQL bag multiplicity losslessly without expanding duplicate solution rows.
Carry explicit default/named graph context and fail-closed exactness/completeness/error outcomes.
Validate large result vectors with bounded deterministic CPU parallelism whose failure identity is scheduling-independent.
Provide Draft 2020-12 schema, fixtures, independent validation, documentation and cumulative gates without enabling OWL Direct completeness claims.
